summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase B+C multi-participant invoice creation rewrite in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx. Tested on public Expo web preview at 390x844 logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL (owner with 10 existing invoices + an active shift). ALL 11 test items PASS. (1) LOGIN → invoices list → new-invoice-btn opens /invoice/new. Screen renders correctly: header 'New Invoice', shared issue-date-input (04/07/2026) + due-date-input, compliance-panel with 6 checks (all initially rendering with correct testIDs check-{name|ndis|contact|issue|due|items}-{ok|missing}), one expanded participant-0 card, add-participant-btn dashed CTA, and a 3-button footer: delete-invoice-btn, save-invoice-btn, send-invoice-btn — all testIDs match spec exactly. (2) FILL P0: tapped link-client-btn-0 → picked pick-client-<id> (Mr. Smittty) → 'Linked: Mr. Smittty' shows in codeBtn, client-field-0 auto-filled 'Mr. Smittty', check-name flipped ok. Tapped ndis-code-btn-0-0, typed '01_011' in code-search, tapped code-01_011_0107_1_1 → modal closed, description auto-filled 'Assistance With Self-Care Activities - Standard - Weekday Daytime', item-rate-0-0 auto-populated 67.56, check-items flipped ok. Set qty=3 → Amount: $202.68. Set due-date-input '31/12/2026' → check-due flipped ok. Compliance progressed 1/6 → 2/6 → 4/6 as fields filled (NDIS + contact remained missing because seed client lacks ndis_number + address). (3) ADD PARTICIPANT: tapped add-participant-btn → participant-0 collapsed (link-client-btn-0 disappeared), participant-1 rendered fresh with its own link-client-btn-1, client-field-1, item-1-0, add-item-btn-1, notes-field-1. Grand total shown as 'Total · 2 invoices $222.95' at the bottom. Expand/collapse participant-0 by tapping participant-head-0 correctly restores its body. (4) COPY ITEM: with 2 participants and participant-0 expanded, tapped copy-item-0-0 → confirmation toast shown, participant-1's items became ['item-1-0','item-1-1'] (initial blank + copied line). Copy button correctly HIDDEN in single-participant mode. (5) SAVE (draft) WITH ACTIVE SHIFT: tapped save-invoice-btn → shift-prompt modal appeared with attach-shift-btn (primary, brand-blue 'Add to current shift') and save-no-shift-btn ('Save without shift'). Tapped save-no-shift-btn → draft saved, router.back to dashboard. On /invoices list count went 10 → 11 total, INV-1011 'Mr. Smittty' DRAFT pill visible at top with $0.00 (no line items on that particular save). (6) SEND NOW single-participant: created a fresh invoice with client + code + due date, tapped send-invoice-btn → invoice created, marked sent, router.back. Verified in /invoices list: count 11 → 12, INV-1012 'Mr. Smittty' at top with 'Sent 0d 15h ago' + UNPAID pill (NOT 'UNSENT'). PDF share via expo Sharing is a no-op on web preview as spec allows — verified no crash and DOM stays clean. (7) DELETE / DISCARD on NEW invoice: tapped delete-invoice-btn → confirmAction fires window.confirm on web (auto-accepted via page.on('dialog')) → returned without saving, no new invoice created. (8) EDIT MODE: opened INV-1012 detail → tapped edit-invoice-btn → navigated to /invoice/new?editId=<id>. Verified: header text 'Edit Invoice' (i18n key invoiceNew.editTitle resolved), ONLY participant-0 present, participant-1 NOT present, add-participant-btn NOT rendered (correct per spec), pre-filled client + NDIS code + rate + due date; footer has all 3 buttons (delete/save/send). Compliance panel shows 4/6 as expected. (9) VALIDATION: with participant-1 having empty name, tapped save-invoice-btn → URL stayed on /invoice/new (did NOT navigate/save), no crash. Note: RN-web Alert.alert() does not render a visible dialog in headless browser, so users won't see the 'Add a name for every participant before saving.' toast on web preview — behaviour is correct (blocks save) but UX suggestion below. (10) i18n: zero raw keys in body text — searched for invoiceNew.sendNow, invoiceNew.participant, invoiceNew.saveDraft, invoiceNew.deleteBtn, invoiceNew.linkClient, invoiceNew.dueDate, invoiceNew.issueDate, invoiceNew.compliant, invoiceNew.complianceProgress, invoiceNew.editTitle across all screens — none leaked. All 82 keys under invoiceNew present in en.json. (11) No runtime crashes. Console shows only pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, tintColor) carried over from iterations 18/19/20 — cosmetic only.

integration_issues.issue: Alert.alert(t('invoiceNew.needName')) in persist() correctly BLOCKS saving when any participant has an empty name (URL stays on /invoice/new, no invoice created) — verified. However, on RN-Web the native Alert.alert() does not render a visible dialog in the DOM, so a user in the web preview sees NOTHING happen when tapping Save with an empty name. Purely a UX/discoverability concern for web; native iOS/Android will show the alert normally. Consider Platform.OS === 'web' fallback using confirmAction/window.alert or an inline error banner. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:201.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings still logged on every navigation; not caused by this iteration. Cosmetic only.

'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' logged once when opening Edit mode. Likely a stray whitespace between JSX siblings. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx (probably around the item header row 347-361 or the codeBtn Text row 318-321 with numberOfLines={1}).

action_items: OPTIONAL UX polish: RN Web Alert.alert() is invisible on the web preview. When persist() rejects on missing participant name (line 201 of invoice/new.tsx), users see no feedback in-browser. Recommend a Platform.OS==='web' branch that either (a) sets a local formError state rendered above the footer, or (b) uses the existing confirmAction/confirm() helpers already imported. Native builds unaffected.
OPTIONAL: Investigate the single 'Unexpected text node' console warning that fires on Edit mode load — likely a stray space in a JSX fragment inside a <View>. Cosmetic; no user-visible impact.

OPTIONAL (carried from iters 18-20): three RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents / Image.style.tintColor) — migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents / props.tintColor when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: invoice/new.tsx is 644 lines — under the 700-line threshold but close. Once further participant/PDF features land it should be split (extract ParticipantCard, CodePickerModal, ClientPickerModal into /src/components).

Multi-participant model is clean: participants[] Participant[] with uid() key generator (Date.now()+seq) prevents duplicate keys. setP / setItem helpers correctly maintain immutability via .map(). addParticipant collapses ALL previous participants (prev.map((p) => ({...p, collapsed:true}))) before appending — matches spec.

persist(): For non-edit path it loops participants and awaits createInvoice sequentially. Consider Promise.all for concurrency if participant counts get large, though sequential is defensible for user-visible progress and DB write-ordering. Edit-path correctly uses editInvoice on the SINGLE participant and no add-participant-btn is rendered (guarded by !isEdit on line 407).
copyItemToOthers spreads {...src} into every OTHER participant.items — correct shallow-copy of Item since it contains only strings. participants[pIdx].items includes the source unchanged.
onSave: standalone-safe — activeShift() failure is swallowed (try/catch { }) so saving never blocks if the shifts endpoint 500s. Attach-shift modal is opt-in only. Good defensive UX.

onDelete uses confirmAction (custom) with destructive=true — on web it degrades to window.confirm; on native it should render the shared confirmation modal. router.back() runs in both new+edit branches; only edit calls api.deleteInvoice.
Validation on line 201: participants.every(p => p.name.trim()) correctly blocks empty-name saves for every participant. However Alert.alert is invisible on web (see action items).
i18n coverage: 82 invoiceNew keys in en.json, all referenced by the screen resolve. No hard-coded English strings observed.

success_rate.frontend: 11/11 scenarios pass (login, screen render, single-participant fill, multi-participant add/collapse, copy-item, save-draft-with-shift-prompt both paths, send-now single, delete/discard new, edit-mode prefilled + no add-participant, empty-name validation blocks save, zero i18n leaks + no crashes)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 net-new invoices on TEST_USER_EMAIL's org during this test run: INV-1011 (DRAFT, Mr. Smittty, $0.00 — line items not fully filled) via Save/save-no-shift path, and INV-1012 (UNPAID, Mr. Smittty, $74.32, 1 line-item code 01_011_0107_1_1 @ $67.56 + GST) via Send-now path. Also 1 discard test (no persistence). If a clean baseline is required for the next iteration, request E1 to delete INV-1011 and INV-1012.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B+C multi-participant invoice creation is fully verified in English on the web preview. TEST_USER_EMAIL currently has an ACTIVE SHIFT, which means the Save (draft) flow will always show the shift-prompt modal — plan for it in future scripts. INV-1011 (draft) and INV-1012 (sent) were created during testing; adjust list-count expectations accordingly if next iteration asserts totals. The 'Sent 0d 15h ago' display (rather than 'just now') is caused by the pre-existing sentAgo() helper in invoices.tsx computing a timezone-offset diff — unchanged from iter 20 and NOT a regression from this phase; noted only for context.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects blocking. Two minor cosmetic notes: (a) RN-Web Alert.alert() invisibility during empty-name validation is a platform limitation, not a bug; behaviour (blocking save) is correct. Fix path: web-only fallback branch. (b) Single 'Unexpected text node' warning at Edit mode load — likely stray whitespace in a JSX fragment inside a <View>. Non-functional. Both listed under action_items as OPTIONAL polish.
